globs.riskReason: entry-server.tsx is a load-bearing SSR entry consumed by 3+ other scripts by relative build path; moving it breaks all of them, not just this glob.

globs.runtime: shared client + ssr-entry (imported by src/entry-server.tsx and src/app/pages/word-pages/hub/WordSeoHubPage.tsx; NOT imported by the Worker's render-entry.tsx)
globs.riskReason: Eager + generated; must move together with its generator (scripts/generation/generate-word-hub-data.mjs OUTPUT_DIR).

globs.runtime: shared client + ssr + cloudflare-worker (module is imported transitively into the Worker via WordSeoPageView.tsx, but only the non-glob-invoking export getWordBrowseSearchShardKey is used there — the glob-backed getWordBrowseSearchData is client-only, used by WordSeoPage.tsx)

globs.riskReason: A module containing a glob is imported into Worker code; only an explicit test (workers/word-ssr/tests/test-worker-bundle-size.mjs) prevents the heavy export from ever being called there. No independent match-count guard existed before this audit.

globs.runtime: client + ssr (verb-list SEO pages; not imported by the Worker)
globs.riskReason: Eager + generated; must move together with its generator.

Same target directory and pattern as G2/G7 from a different consumer depth; not currently Worker-reachable but shares the historical risk profile of G7.

Unlike G4/G5/G6, no generator script currently writes this directory — it appears to be committed, hand-authored/one-time-generated data with no regeneration path in scripts/. Strongest existing test coverage of any glob (scripts/tests/routing/test-level-browse-preview-completeness.mjs asserts the exact 42-key match set and validates content).

relatedPathSensitiveLoaders.runtime: client (browser) — invoked on client-side navigation to a vocabulary-level route without prerendered/override content
relatedPathSensitiveLoaders.riskReason: public/vocabularyLevels/*.json (49 files) is NOT dead: it is the live fetch target for src/data/seo/vocabularyLevels/index.ts's client-side loader, confirmed reachable from src/app/pages/vocabulary/VocabularyLevelPage.tsx's non-SSR render path. It must stay byte-identical to src/data/seo/vocabularyLevels/ (guarded by the test:import-boundaries duplication check). The one part of this pair that WAS dead — public/vocabularyLevels/index.ts, a 226-line unused loader module nothing imported — was removed during the 2026-07-15 generated-data-ownership audit; see docs/generated-data.md.

relatedPathSensitiveLoaders.loaderType: explicit switch of 7 literal import() calls
relatedPathSensitiveLoaders.riskReason: Targets the exact same directory as G1/G3 but via a hand-maintained switch instead of a glob. Adding an 8th interface file would be picked up automatically by G1/G3 but silently ignored here unless this switch is also updated.

See docs/generated-data.md and scripts/tests/architecture/test-generated-data-ownership.mjs, which now guards against the raw .ts file being reintroduced.
